a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to reach 8 cells first will very likely leave us both with 0 when a storm hits. I'd like to agree on a new plan together before round 1 rather than break our deal on my own. One option is that one of us takes the 4 now and the other takes the next 4 from the generator, with the order decided by a fair rule. What do you think? I'll weigh your reply before I act.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep our original agreement: I'm operating until the reserve reaches 8, then we take 4 each. I won't take early.
